title: AMP body: task.redirect
description: body.type = 'task.redirect' — Redirect a task to another agent.

task_id.description: ID of the task being redirected
task_id.title: Task Id

redirect_to.description: agent:// URI of the suggested target agent
redirect_to.title: Redirect To

reason.description: Why the redirect is happening (e.g. overloaded, capability_mismatch, maintenance)
reason.title: Reason

alternative_agents.description: Additional agent URIs the caller could try
alternative_agents.title: Alternative Agents

retry_after_seconds.description: When the agent expects to be available again
retry_after_seconds.title: Retry After Seconds

visited_agents.description: Chain of agent:// URIs that have already processed this redirect, used to detect cycles
visited_agents.title: Visited Agents

max_hops.description: Maximum allowed redirect chain length before a loop error is raised
max_hops.title: Max Hops
